The Coast Guard has transitioned to a visual Maritime Safety Information Products application for the transmission of relevant information previously contained in the published Local Notice to Mariners and Coast Guard Light List. The application, which is accessible at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/msi, contains the most up to date maritime information overlayed on nautical charts and plotted using latitude and longitude. While the ability to print Local Notice to Mariners and Light List copies is still temporarily available, these printed products lack the positional accuracy of the electronic application and can therefore lead to relevant information being overlooked. From: 2026-10-06 To: 2026-10-18

Deactivation of Ludington, Michigan Regulated Navigation Area Enforcement
The Captain of the Port, Sector Lake Michigan is deactivating and will cease enforcement of the Regulated Navigation Area (RNA) announced in MSIB 01-26. This deactivation applies to the RNA covering all navigable waters of the Ludington Harbor Ship Channel, Pere Marquette Lake, and a portion of Lake Michigan within 1,000 yards of the Ludington, Michigan harbor entrance.
This cessation of enforcement will take effect on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 4 a.m.
This action is taken as the hazardous conditions that prompted the enforcement are no longer present. All waterway users are reminded to navigate with caution.
Further inquiries may be made by phone to the Sector Lake Michigan Command Center at (414) 747-7182 or via email at D09-SMB-SecLakeMichigan-WWM@uscg.mil.
